description: A React component page for managing connector services, including listing services, starting/stopping them, and handling various UI states.

methods.name: toMessage
methods.description: Converts unknown errors to user-friendly messages, handling Error instances, strings, or fallbacks.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the list of services from the API and updates the component state.

methods.name: handleStart
methods.description: Starts a specified service by id and refreshes the list.

methods.name: handleStop
methods.description: Stops a specified service by id and refreshes the list.
